summary: Prioritized findings: P0 — repair the human-knowledge ingestion boundary identified by the first project inspection. NoteFrontmatter omits required authority, owner, privacy, review, affected-path, and supersession metadata and models confidence incompatibly; scan_vault ingests Markdown as uniformly human semantic memory without authority/status classification, privacy enforcement, provenance, or canonical-reliance gating; MemoryStore does not persist serialized records; and tests omit these contract requirements (core/projects/tasks/queue.jsonl:48209). Smallest repair: align NoteFrontmatter with docs/human-knowledge-ingestion-contract.md, classify and gate records before MemoryRecord creation, persist through the existing store boundary, and add focused contract/privacy/provenance/persistence tests. P0 — stop duplicate task-graph materialization: the recent canonical ledger repeatedly appends execute/verify pairs for the same objective and plan across many timestamped IDs (core/projects/tasks/queue.jsonl:48518-48618). Smallest repair: enforce objective-plus-plan-leaf idempotency before append and make startup/timer reconciliation reuse the existing nonterminal leaf rather than rematerializing it. P1 — complete the remaining product gates instead of adding isolated schemas: same-objective deferred/recurring wake remains open, reviewed-real-project shared-objective joined close remains open, and Vairë context-use plus operator-burden acceptance remain open (docs/plans/autonomous-task-completion/README.md:33-37; 02-installed-scheduling-restart.md:14-20; 04-real-multi-project-execution.md:14-33). Smallest repair: run one canonical operator objective through two reviewed project contracts, a scheduled wake and restart, independent critic-driven correction, joined checks, Vairë receipts, and Hermes controls. P1 — replace proof/disposable registry authority with truthful real-project contracts and exact digests; data/workbench/projects.json still mixes root-level proof contracts, disposable target projects, and only two reviewed read-only projects, while the whole-system plan requires production authority over real bounded projects (data/workbench/projects.json:1-583; docs/plans/ARDA_WHOLE_SYSTEM_COMPLETION_PROGRAM.md:66-73). P2 — activate daily improvement only after the completion loop is trustworthy, then prove seven installed cycles containing a verified improvement, justified no-change, and correct rejection (docs/plans/ARDA_WHOLE_SYSTEM_COMPLETION_PROGRAM.md:75-83). The second project inspection found no concrete defect or unsupported completion claim and requires no repair (core/projects/tasks/queue.jsonl:48623). Capability truth remains substantial source/package and bounded installed proof, not whole-system or operator-accepted completion (ARDA_SYSTEM_STATUS_REPORT.md:47-50; docs/plans/AUTONOMOUS_TASK_COMPLETION_LOOP.md:23-36). Read-only inspection completed without modifying files or running the verifier-owned cargo check.
